description: This file contains functions for handling attachments in the Notesnook project, including downloading, saving, decrypting, checking, and previewing image attachments, with integration of React components for UI display.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Fetches attachment data and decrypts the file for download.

methods.name: saveAttachment
methods.description: Downloads and saves an attachment file locally.

methods.name: downloadAttachment
methods.description: Downloads an attachment and returns it in specified format (blob, base64, text).

methods.name: checkAttachment
methods.description: Verifies attachment existence and upload status, marks as failed if needed.

methods.name: previewImageAttachment
methods.description: Displays a preview of an image attachment using a Lightbox component.
